# CAD mass and CG audit (generated by cad/audit.py)

CAD masses: made parts = CAD volume x density (fea/materials.json, cad/e8cad/config.py); COTS placeholders = catalog or design masses at their CAD positions; occupants at the design points; the growth allowance is not modelled and is carried at its design point. Design values: design/geometry.json mass_items (same totals as selected_design.json).

## Totals

| case | design kg | CAD kg | diff kg | diff % | design CG x, z (m) | CAD CG x, z (m) | dx (m) | dz (m) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| empty (incl. growth) | 825.7 | 813.6 | -12.1 | -1.5 | 3.046, 1.670 | 3.068, 1.692 | +0.022 | +0.022 |
| MTOW (pilot + passenger) | 1350.4 | 1330.2 | -20.1 | -1.5 | 2.562, 1.320 | 2.576, 1.333 | +0.014 | +0.013 |
| pilot only | 1250.4 | 1230.2 | -20.1 | -1.6 | 2.603, 1.335 | 2.619, 1.350 | +0.016 | +0.015 |

Static margin at MTOW: design 0.098, with the CAD CG 0.086 (shift -0.012 of MAC, neutral point unchanged).
